description: Ollama with two models, one deliberately outside the 'library' namespace.
demo_beat: step 2 - expand Ollama, show the models
why: model >= 2 is the whole point. Hardcoding registry.ollama.ai/library returns 1 and looks perfectly healthy - the hf.co model is the only way to catch it. brew is >=1 and covers both a Cellar and a Caskroom row. daemon is 0 by design: Ollama's LaunchAgent is a first-GUI-launch side effect and SSH has no Aqua session, so 50-autonomous carries the daemon branch instead.
